text:
I will dance on a carpet of green,

have ready the wine in the ringing glass,

we shall drink the golden liquor

celebrating the night and its freshness.


I will dance like the pure earth,

like the earth I shall be a treasure,

and in giving myself pure I shall find no dishonor,

for giving oneself is a form of height.


I will dance so that you forget everything

and I shall give you the intoxication you ask

until Venus passes through the skies.


But perhaps something will be hidden from you,

for pagan woman of an impoverished century,

I shall not let all the veils fall.

translation.title: Modern
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the speaker's self-possession and the withheld final veil.
